submission_format: A single Python module named solution.py

evaluation.pass_rule: All correctness tests pass and the weighted score is at least 0.7

title: Dataset Explorer
summary: Compute robust descriptive statistics on a dataset with missing values.
requirements: column_stats(rows, column) returns count, missing, mean, median and population std, ignoring None values
If every value is missing, mean/median/std are None
group_mean(rows, by, column) returns the mean of column per group, ignoring missing values
Do not modify the input rows
description: Rows are dictionaries, e.g. `{'city': 'Pune', 'temp': 31.5}`. Values may be `None` (missing). Implement `column_stats` and `group_mean` in plain Python (no pandas).
